$comment: Stream catalogue. Curated by hand, embeddability verified by npm run check:catalogue. Coordinates point at the camera where it is known, and at the reserve or lodge for the wildlife cameras, which are deliberately not published to the metre.

streams.title: Masjid al-Haram
streams.description: The Kaaba and the surrounding mataf, around the clock. Operated by Saudi Arabia's official Quran TV channel.

streams.title: Masjid al-Haram, second angle
streams.description: A backup feed from the same mosque. If the primary stream drops, the map point stays alive instead of turning into a dead link.

streams.title: Masjid al-Haram, third angle
streams.description: A third feed of the Grand Mosque from the same broadcaster. Mecca is the busiest point on this map and the one worth keeping redundant.

streams.title: Masjid an-Nabawi
streams.description: The Prophet's Mosque in Medina, around the clock. Operated by Saudi Arabia's official Sunnah TV channel.

streams.title: Western Wall plaza
streams.description: An EarthCam view over the plaza in Jerusalem's Old City. Al-Aqsa itself is out of frame: no permanent stream from the mosque exists on YouTube.

streams.title: Imam Ali Shrine
streams.description: The golden dome and courtyard at Najaf, from the shrine administration itself rather than a restream.

streams.title: Karbala, the two shrines
streams.description: The courtyards of Imam Hussein and al-Abbas, streamed by the Abbas shrine itself. Dozens of channels rebroadcast this feed; this is the source.

streams.title: Al-Kadhimiya Shrine
streams.description: The twin domes and four minarets in north-western Baghdad, from the shrine administration.

streams.title: Imam Reza Shrine
streams.description: The largest mosque in the world by area, at Mashhad, streamed by Astan Quds itself.

streams.title: The Yiti cliffs, Muscat
streams.description: The coast south-east of Muscat, where the Hajar mountains meet the Gulf of Oman.

streams.title: Nevsky Prospekt at Gostiny Dvor
streams.description: The busiest stretch of the main avenue, opposite the old merchant arcade.

streams.title: Nevsky Prospekt at Sadovaya
streams.description: The same avenue a block west, looking across the Sadovaya junction.

streams.title: Senate Square and the Bronze Horseman
streams.description: From the Admiralty Embankment pier across to Senate Square, with Peter the Great's monument and St Isaac's dome behind it.

streams.title: Palace Embankment and the Neva
streams.description: The Neva looking upstream from the Palace pier, opposite the Hermitage. River traffic crosses the frame all day through the navigation season.

streams.title: Palace Bridge
streams.description: The bascule bridge over the Neva, which opens for shipping in the small hours of the night.

streams.title: Griboedov Canal
streams.description: A quiet stretch of canal in the centre, the city at the scale it was actually built to.

streams.title: Cruiser Aurora
streams.description: The 1900 cruiser at her permanent mooring on the Bolshaya Nevka.

streams.title: Hotel Indigo rooftop
streams.description: A steerable camera on a rooftop terrace, looking out over the roofs of the central districts.

streams.title: Petrogradsky Island
streams.description: North of the Neva, over the roofs of the Petrogradskaya side towards the centre.

streams.title: Bogatyrsky Avenue crossroads
streams.description: An ordinary junction in the northern districts, which is most of what a city actually is.

streams.title: Samara riverfront
streams.description: The Volga bank at the Rossiya hotel, one of the longest embankments on the river.

streams.title: Chelyabinsk, South Ural University
streams.description: The university tower and the square in front of it, in the southern Urals.

streams.title: Perm, steerable city camera
streams.description: A camera the chat can aim, which makes the stream half a view and half a toy.

streams.title: Perm Expo
streams.description: The exhibition grounds on the edge of the city, also under chat control.

streams.title: Solikamsk
streams.description: A salt-mining town in the northern Perm region, five hundred years old and rarely filmed.

streams.title: Lyubinsky Avenue, Omsk
streams.description: The nineteenth-century merchant street in the middle of Siberia.

streams.title: The Lena at Lensk
streams.description: The river that freezes solid every winter and carries everything the town needs every summer.

streams.title: Lensk town centre
streams.description: A small town in Yakutia, two thousand kilometres from the nearest city of any size.

streams.title: Trinity Suburb, Minsk
streams.description: The rebuilt old quarter on the Svislach, the one piece of pre-war Minsk that reads as old.

streams.title: Storozhovskaya Street, Minsk
streams.description: A residential street near the river, filmed for no reason other than that someone lives there.

streams.title: Grushevsky Square, Minsk
streams.description: A neighbourhood park in the south-west of the city.

streams.title: Dzerzhinsky Avenue, Minsk
streams.description: The avenue running out towards Grushevka metro, traffic and all.

streams.title: Ala-Too Square
streams.description: The central square of Bishkek, with the flagpole and the Kyrgyz Ala-Too range behind it. Operated by Saima Telecom, a Kyrgyz internet provider, rather than restreamed.

streams.title: Tallinn old town
streams.description: The medieval roofs and spires of the upper town, in 4K.

streams.title: Namib Desert waterhole
streams.description: A remote waterhole in the Gondwana Namib Park, beside the Namib-Naukluft. Oryx, springbok and jackals come and go; at night the frame belongs to whatever the desert sends.

streams.title: Senyati waterhole
streams.description: A hide sunk to eye level with the water, on the elephant routes near Kasane.

streams.title: Kalahari salt pan
streams.description: The Makgadikgadi pans, flat to the horizon in every direction.

streams.title: Jack's Camp waterhole
streams.description: A Kalahari waterhole with elephants and lions on the far bank.

streams.title: The Basin hide, Selinda
streams.description: A sunken hide in the Selinda Reserve, where the camera sits below the animals.

streams.title: Twin Pan hide, Zarafa
streams.description: A second Selinda hide on a pair of pans that draw game through the dry season.

streams.title: Meno a Kwena, Boteti River
streams.description: Zebra crossing the Boteti during the second-largest zebra migration in Africa.

streams.title: Moela, Boteti River
streams.description: The same river a few kilometres on, from a lodge on the west bank.

streams.title: Camelthorn waterhole
streams.description: Zebra and hippo at a Botswana waterhole named for the thorn trees around it.

streams.title: Deteema Springs, Hwange
streams.description: A spring in the north of Hwange National Park, Zimbabwe.

streams.title: Linkwasha waterhole, Hwange
streams.description: The south-east corner of Hwange, on one of the park pumped waterholes.

streams.title: Angama Mara
streams.description: The Maasai Mara from the escarpment above the Great Rift Valley.

streams.title: Mara River, Fig Tree crossing
streams.description: One of the crossings the wildebeest use in the migration months, and where the crocodiles wait.

streams.title: Mara River, main crossing
streams.description: The main crossing point downstream, watched around the clock.

streams.title: Mahali Mzuri
streams.description: Open Mara grassland from the Motorogi conservancy.

streams.title: Angama Amboseli
streams.description: Amboseli scrub with Kilimanjaro on the skyline when the cloud lifts.

streams.title: Tortilis waterhole, Amboseli
streams.description: A waterhole under Kilimanjaro, on the Tanzanian border.

streams.title: Ol Pejeta rhino camp
streams.description: The conservancy where the last two northern white rhino live under guard.

streams.title: Finch Hattons, Tsavo
streams.description: Spring-fed pools in Tsavo West, named after the hunter buried on the hill above.

streams.title: ol Donyo, Chyulu Hills
streams.description: The Chyulu Hills between Amboseli and Tsavo, big-tusker country.

streams.title: The Serengeti
streams.description: The Tanzanian half of the same ecosystem as the Mara, and the other half of the migration.

streams.title: Nkorho Bush Lodge, Sabi Sand
streams.description: A Sabi Sand waterhole, in the reserve that shares an unfenced border with Kruger.

streams.title: Ulusaba, Sabi Sand
streams.description: A second Sabi Sand camera on a rocky outcrop above the bush.

streams.title: Roy's Dam, Sabi Sand
streams.description: A dam that concentrates everything in the reserve into one frame in the dry months.

streams.title: Naledi, Greater Kruger
streams.description: A waterhole in the Balule reserve on the western edge of Kruger.

streams.title: Simbavati, Klaserie
streams.description: The Klaserie riverbed, dry sand for most of the year.

streams.title: Skukuza, Kruger
streams.description: Beside the Sabie River at the main camp of Kruger National Park.

streams.title: Tembe Elephant Park
streams.description: Sand-forest country on the Mozambique border, and the tallest elephants in Africa.

streams.title: Maho Beach approach
streams.description: The approach to Princess Juliana International, where aircraft cross the beach a few metres above the sand.

streams.title: Harry Reid International
streams.description: Runways 26R and 26L at Las Vegas, with the Strip behind them.

streams.title: LaGuardia
streams.description: New York's short-runway airport, hemmed in by Flushing Bay.

streams.title: Louis Armstrong International
streams.description: The New Orleans field, named after the trumpeter born a few miles away.

streams.title: Reno-Tahoe International
streams.description: A high-desert airport with the Sierra Nevada on the skyline.

streams.title: Lanzarote Airport
streams.description: The Canary Islands field, on black volcanic ground.

streams.title: Miami International, runway 9/27
streams.description: The runway with tower radio patched into the stream.

streams.title: Midway Airport
streams.description: Chicago's older field, wedged into the street grid on the south-west side.

streams.title: Key West harbour
streams.description: The end of the Florida Keys, with marine radio over the picture.

streams.title: Canada Place, Vancouver
streams.description: The cruise terminal under the white sails, with the North Shore mountains behind.

streams.title: Fort Lauderdale Beach
streams.description: The beach road and the Atlantic beyond it.

streams.title: Anglins Pier
streams.description: A fishing pier north of Fort Lauderdale, out over the surf.

streams.title: Siesta Key Beach
streams.description: Quartz sand on the Gulf coast, white enough to stay cool underfoot.

streams.title: Clearwater Beach
streams.description: The Gulf at Clearwater, from a restaurant deck on the sand.

streams.title: Sanibel Island
streams.description: A shelling beach on a barrier island off Fort Myers.

streams.title: Hollywood Beach Broadwalk
streams.description: Four kilometres of promenade between the hotels and the Atlantic.

streams.title: Seaside Heights
streams.description: A New Jersey boardwalk town, quiet nine months of the year.

streams.title: Wildwood boardwalk
streams.description: The widest beach on the Jersey shore, and the piers along it.

streams.title: Beach Bar, Cruz Bay
streams.description: Cruz Bay on St John, in the US Virgin Islands.

streams.title: Seychelles shoreline
streams.description: Granite boulders and open Indian Ocean, with the surf on the audio track.

streams.title: Koh Phangan
streams.description: A Gulf of Thailand beach in stereo sound.

streams.title: Fisherman's Village, Koh Samui
streams.description: The old Chinese shophouse street at Bophut, on the north shore of Samui.

streams.title: Lamai Beach, Koh Samui
streams.description: The east-coast beach, which gets the sunrise the other side misses.

streams.title: Venice Beach
streams.description: The boardwalk at Venice, Los Angeles, from a hotel balcony above it.

streams.title: Tamariu
streams.description: A small cove on the Costa Brava, in Catalonia.

streams.title: Mallorca
streams.description: The Balearic coast, from a hotel above the water.

streams.title: Times Square
streams.description: The north end of the square, lit brightly enough that the camera never needs night mode.

streams.title: World Trade Center
streams.description: Lower Manhattan from above the rebuilt site.

streams.title: 9/11 Memorial
streams.description: The two voids where the towers stood, water falling into them all day.

streams.title: Brooklyn Bridge
streams.description: The 1883 bridge and the traffic across it.

streams.title: Philadelphia skyline
streams.description: The centre of the city from across the roofs.

streams.title: Liberty Bell
streams.description: The bell in its glass pavilion, with Independence Hall behind.

streams.title: Washington Monument
streams.description: The obelisk on the Mall, from the far end of the Reflecting Pool.

streams.title: The White House
streams.description: The north front from Lafayette Square, across Pennsylvania Avenue.

streams.title: Tower of Voices
streams.description: Forty wind chimes on a Pennsylvania hillside, one for each person on Flight 93.

streams.title: Bourbon Street
streams.description: The French Quarter at street level, busiest long after midnight.

streams.title: French Quarter balcony
streams.description: The same quarter from a wrought-iron balcony above it.

streams.title: Milwaukee
streams.description: The lakefront city on the western shore of Lake Michigan.

streams.title: Council Bluffs
streams.description: A Missouri River town on the Iowa side, opposite Omaha.

streams.title: Madison, Indiana
streams.description: An Ohio River town whose whole centre is a historic district.

streams.title: Roswell
streams.description: Main Street in the New Mexico town that has made a living out of one night in 1947.

streams.title: Ruidoso
streams.description: A village in the Sacramento Mountains at two kilometres above sea level.

streams.title: World's Largest Buffalo
streams.description: A twenty-six-tonne concrete bison standing over Interstate 94 in North Dakota.

streams.title: Santa Clara Valley
streams.description: South of San Jose, looking down the valley from Morgan Hill.

streams.title: San Francisco Bay
streams.description: The bay towards the Golden Gate, from the waterfront.

streams.title: Abbey Road crossing
streams.description: The zebra crossing on the Beatles sleeve, and everyone who stops to re-enact it.

streams.title: Dublin
streams.description: The centre of the Irish capital from above the street.

streams.title: Santa Claus Village
streams.description: The Arctic Circle line runs through the yard, marked on the ground in lights.

streams.title: Sydney Harbour
streams.description: The bridge and the opera house from the north shore.

streams.title: Tokyo Bay
streams.description: The bay and the towers behind it, in 4K.

streams.title: Kabukicho
streams.description: The Shinjuku entertainment district, awake all night.

streams.title: The Han River
streams.description: Seoul from Yeouido, with the bridges over the Han lit at night.

streams.title: Agdao, Davao City
streams.description: A tyre shop and a sari-sari store on a Mindanao street corner.

streams.title: Bandar Puteri, Puchong
streams.description: A Kuala Lumpur suburb from a security-company camera on a tower block.

streams.title: Kilpisjärvi, north view
streams.description: Finnish Lapland pointed at the aurora, three hundred kilometres inside the Arctic Circle.

streams.title: Pigeon River
streams.description: Whitewater coming out of the Great Smoky Mountains in Tennessee.

streams.title: Spirit Lake
streams.description: A glacial lake in northern Iowa, frozen for a third of the year.

streams.title: Snowman Cam
streams.description: A northern Michigan feeding station: deer, turkeys and whatever else turns up.

streams.title: Giraffe barn, Greenville Zoo
streams.description: The indoor half of the giraffe enclosure, which is where they spend cold nights.

streams.title: National Aquarium
streams.description: A tank in Baltimore, from the visitor side of the glass.
